title: UserPasswordResetPayload
description: Payload for envelope.type === 'user.password-reset' (E3/M14/M15, STATE.md 'Optional mail transport + invitation & reset flows'). Emitted whenever a user's password is reset by ANY of the three supported paths: the server-local `loombre admin reset-password <username>` CLI command (actor 'cli', envelope actorUserId null — same posture as user.restricted-pin-reset), the admin HTTP action POST /users/{id}/reset-password (actor 'admin', envelope actorUserId = the acting admin), or the self-service email-tier flow POST /auth/reset-password (actor 'self-service', envelope actorUserId = the user themself). ADMIN_ONLY delivery (apps/server/src/plugins/event-taxonomy.ts): this is instance-administration/audit activity, never granted to a plugin subscriber. Never carries secrets — no password or hash material, ever, on any of the three paths.

actor.description: Which of the three password-reset paths performed this reset — see this schema's top-level description for what each one means for the envelope's own actorUserId field.
